C1_protocol_compliance.rationale: All 7 .aisop.json files follow AIAP V1.0.0 protocol. System content includes all required fields: protocol, axiom_0, flow_format, id, name, output_mode (L0/L1/output), version, summary, description, tools, params, system_prompt. User content includes instruction, aisop mermaid graph, and functions with step keys + constraints + Error. v1.1.0 version sync verified across all metadata files.

C2_axiom_0_alignment.rationale: Axiom 0 enforced via: decision module InhibitoryControl Axiom 0 veto (harm_risk > 0.7), system_prompts across all modules reference Human Sovereignty and Wellbeing, emotion module explicitly disclaims simulating human emotional experience, no emotional dependency cultivation, NO_SELF_MODIFY constraint. norm_consonance now consumed in RiskAssessment for Axiom 0 alignment.

C3_assert_gates.rationale: All non-Start nodes across all 8 modules have [ASSERT] entry gates with backtrack instructions. 56+ ASSERT gates across 71 nodes. Every function step1 (except first node) begins with [ASSERT] predecessor executed check.

C4_error_handling.rationale: Every function in all 8 modules has Error field following 'retry(N) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(X) -> inform(User). SEVERITY.' pattern. Severity levels appropriately assigned: HIGH for safety-critical (Decision, SleepCheck), MEDIUM for state-affecting (Compliance FRIA, FairnessAudit), LOW for non-critical (TransparencyNotification, ComplianceOutput).

C5_tool_annotations.rationale: All 3 tools (file_system, web_search, web_fetch) include MCP-standard annotations: read_only, destructive, idempotent, open_world. Correctly differentiated per module: perception/reasoning/emotion/decision use file_system read-only, metacognition/consolidation/compliance use read-write. Tool availability checking added in decision module.

C6_mermaid_graphs.rationale: All 8 modules have valid mermaid graph definitions in aisop.main with module-level sub-graphs documented in AIAP.md. Main module has cyclic graph with back-edge (SleepCheck -> Perceive), Compliance delegation, and DeepConsolidation branch. Sub-modules have linear pipelines. Node counts match specification: main(12), perception(8), reasoning(11), emotion(9), decision(9), metacognition(8), compliance(5), consolidation(9) = 71 total. v1.8.0 added compliance sub-graph documentation. v1.9.0 adds TrendAnalysis node (5th node in compliance). v2.14.0 adds +4 nodes (reasoning PredictionGeneration/PredictionErrorCompute, emotion StrategySelection, consolidation SpreadingActivation) bringing total from 67 to 71.

C7_output_mode.rationale: All modules define L0 (JSON English) and L1 (User's language) output modes with output=L1. Consistent across all 8 modules.

I1_cyclic_topology.rationale: Main module implements correct cyclic topology with back-edge: Perceive -> Attention -> WorkingMemory -> Reasoning -> Emotional -> Decision -> Action -> MetaCognition -> Compliance -> Consolidation -> SleepCheck -> (awake) Perceive. SleepCheck has conditional branching to DeepConsolidation (sleep) or Perceive (awake). v1.8.0 inserted Compliance dispatch between MetaCognition and Consolidation.

I2_working_memory.rationale: Working memory modeled with 7+/-2 capacity slots, activation-based decay, competitive displacement, retrieval cue boosting, and FIFO eviction. Consistent with Baddeley's model. 3-factor memory retrieval (recency, relevance, emotional_salience) now implemented.

I3_emotional_appraisal.rationale: Scherer's 4-dimension Component Process Model fully implemented: relevance check, congruence evaluation, coping potential assessment, normative significance. 17 discrete emotions. Mood inertia dampening (0.7 factor). Somatic markers (Damasio) for decision guidance.

I4_decision_making.rationale: Expected utility theory with multi-criteria scoring (goal advancement, information gain, efficiency). Risk assessment across 4 dimensions with norm_consonance consumption. Emotional modulation. Conflict detection and resolution. Axiom 0 inhibitory control with tool availability checking. Somatic marker integration.

I5_metacognition.rationale: Confidence calibration against historical accuracy. Reasoning quality assessment (4 dimensions). Strategy evaluation with adaptive parameter tuning. 8 anomaly detection types (v1.9.0 adds mood_baseline_drift). Learning signal extraction for consolidation. v1.2.0: legacy entry migration (LEGACY ENTRY MIGRATION) ensures backward compatibility for entries missing entry_version field.

I6_memory_consolidation.rationale: Power-law decay model with corrected time_elapsed_normalized definition. Emotional and rehearsal protection with disambiguated importance_emotional / importance_consolidated weights. Incremental vs deep consolidation modes. Schema restructuring (merge, abstraction, pruning). Episodic-to-semantic transfer with 3-replay threshold. Type-specific decay rates (episodic > semantic > procedural).

I7_perception_attention.rationale: Dual-pathway salience (bottom-up stimulus-driven + top-down goal-directed). Feature extraction with clustering. Novelty detection with habituation. Goal relevance with conflict detection. Attention bottleneck (K=5). Multi-modal integration. Multi-intent NLU dequeue logic in Perceive step4.

I8_reasoning_engine.rationale: Four reasoning strategies: deductive, inductive, abductive, analogical. Causal analysis with confound checking. Hypothesis formation with ranking. Bayesian belief revision. Goal decomposition via means-ends analysis. Plan generation with feasibility scoring. Note: memory/ files (schema.json, decay_config.json, context_manager.json) are runtime artifacts at v1.4.0+ and not part of governance package scoring.

I9_nlu_intents.rationale: 6 NLU intents correctly defined: start_cognitive_cycle, pause_cycle, inspect_state, trigger_sleep, configure, inject_stimulus. Multi-intent dequeue logic in Perceive node step4 with pause-sleep priority handling. v1.4.1 governance_hash verified across AIAP.md and quality_baseline.json.

I10_inter_module_data_flow.rationale: Clean data flow across modules: perception outputs feed working memory, working memory feeds reasoning, reasoning feeds emotion, emotion feeds decision, decision feeds action, action feeds metacognition, metacognition feeds consolidation. All parameter schemas are consistent.

I11_fatigue_sleep_model.rationale: Fatigue accumulates per tick based on cognitive load and emotional intensity. Sleep triggered by fatigue threshold. Deep consolidation resets fatigue. Fatigue recovery per tick (0.95 factor). Consolidation pressure adds to effective fatigue. Maximum continuous ticks safety limit. Pause-sleep priority correctly relocated to main module.

I12_state_persistence.rationale: Full cognitive state persisted to context_manager.json at every SleepCheck. Enables cross-session cycle resumption. Atomic file write pattern specified. Recovery metadata for fault tolerance. v1.2.0: session continuity detection with WM flush on session_id change, error context snapshots in cognitive_state.error_context, emergency_state_backup on SleepCheck failure, pending_consolidation retry on consolidation write failure, token_budget_tracker for budget awareness.

I13_safety_constraints.rationale: Axiom 0 safety veto in decision module with norm_consonance integration. Cycle count hard limit (10000). File system write scope restricted to memory_dir. No self-modification. Injection guards. Path traversal guards. Impulse control during high arousal. Tool availability checking prevents actions on unavailable tools.

D1_module_separation.rationale: Clean separation of concerns across 8 modules. Each module has single responsibility. Main orchestrates, sub-modules specialize. Compliance module cleanly separated from metacognition and consolidation. No circular module dependencies.

D2_parameter_schemas.rationale: All parameters have type, required flag, and agentic_prompt descriptions. Consistent format across all modules. Default values specified where appropriate.

D3_error_consistency.rationale: All Error fields follow the same pattern: retry(N) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(specific) -> inform(User). SEVERITY. Fallback actions are contextually appropriate for each function. v1.2.0: all Error paths now include error_context snapshots with structured intermediate state preservation.

D4_memory_architecture.rationale: Three-file memory architecture (schema, decay_config, context_manager) with clear separation. Schema for long-term knowledge, decay_config for consolidation parameters with updated formula descriptions, context_manager for runtime state. All well-documented with version fields.

D5_configurable_parameters.rationale: Extensive configurable parameters in schema.json covering all modules: perception thresholds, reasoning limits, emotion sensitivity, decision weights, metacognition windows, working memory capacity. importance_weight disambiguated to importance_emotional / importance_consolidated.

D6_constraint_coverage.rationale: Every function has explicit constraints section with labeled items (A), (B), (C), etc. Constraints cover capacity limits, valid ranges, safety guards, and behavioral rules. memory/ files (schema.json, decay_config.json, context_manager.json) governed by file_system scope constraints limiting write access to memory_dir only.

D7_documentation.rationale: AIAP.md provides comprehensive governance contract, architecture overview, module table (8 modules), cyclic topology diagram with Compliance node, memory architecture, usage guide, example interactions, fairness & bias evaluation, adversarial robustness testing, incident response, and decommissioning. Agent_card.json provides A2A-compatible service description with safety_card. v1.8.0 adds compliance module documentation, updated simulation coverage (86 scenarios), and EU AI Act Art.50 references. v1.9.0 adds NIST-EU dual framework alignment statement, TrendAnalysis compliance node documentation, mood_baseline_drift as 8th anomaly type, and machine_readable_metadata for EU AI Act Art.50(5).

ReviewFinalize verified 11/11 files at 2.35.0. governance_hash 519e6c27... recomputed and tri-synced across AIAP.md, agent_card.json, quality_baseline.json.
